text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq assails Turkey for joint military exercises with Israel.
- Turkish energy minister in Baghdad to secure gas and oil purchases from Iraq.
- Trade Minister Mohammad Mehdi Saleh says trade ties with Morocco will develop.
- Large quantities of wheat, rice and vegetable oil bought under the oil-for-food deal are expected to reach Iraq next week.
